svg.title: Deploy $30,000 Without Funding Unbounded Custom Work
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Deploy $30,000 Without Funding Unbounded Custom Work; subtitle: Four capital buckets distinguish setup spending from operating runway.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values are USD allocations in one illustrative $30,000 startup stack, inside the canonical $5,000–$60,000 range. They are not additional annual expenses in the Base waterfall. Cash reserved for future spending is not an expense merely because it is allocated.; caption: $6,000 + $4,500 + $3,000 + $16,500 = $30,000. The $16,500 reserve covers three months at an assumed $5,500 monthly cash burn, within the $2,500–$18,000 operating range. A first deal may take 1–4 months.; stages: label: Reusable delivery foundation; value: $6,000 allocated to fixtures, reference workflows, and setup; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Allocate 20% to synthetic datasets, connector templates, evaluation harnesses, and deployment automation. Build one repeatable workflow package before purchasing tools for additional niches.; label: Commercial validation assets; value: $4,500 allocated to discovery, demonstrations, and targeted selling; numeric value: 4500.0; detail: Allocate 15% to buyer interviews, a measured demonstration, concise offer materials, and CRM setup. Track qualified conversations rather than buying broad traffic before scope and pricing work.; label: Contracts and secure workspace; value: $3,000 allocated to engagement documents and access setup; numeric value: 3000.0; detail: Allocate 10% to reviewed engagement templates, processing terms, insurance setup, a password manager, and segregated workspaces. Distinguish one-time setup from later recurring subscriptions.; label: Working-capital reserve; value: $16,500 held for operating burn and collection delays; numeric value: 16500.0; detail: Allocate 55% to cash runway rather than discretionary features. At $5,500 monthly burn, a fourth month needs another $5,500; reduce burn or secure additional funding before committing to unfunded obligations.

rect.title: label: Reusable delivery foundation; numeric value: 6000.0; value: $6,000 allocated to fixtures, reference workflows, and setup; detail: Allocate 20% to synthetic datasets, connector templates, evaluation harnesses, and deployment automation. Build one repeatable workflow package before purchasing tools for additional niches.
